name: HR commuter benefit policy example
answer: Employees may enroll in the commuter benefit before the first day of the month. Employees may submit parking receipts within 90 days. The company guarantees reimbursement for every commuting expense.

sources.title: HR Commuter Benefit Policy
sources.content: Employees may enroll in the commuter benefit before the first day of the month. Parking receipts must be submitted within 60 days. The benefit covers eligible public-transit and parking expenses up to the monthly limit.
